name: 四支装多口味滋润唇膏礼盒款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清这是多支护唇组合装，赢下首图点击。
俯拍散开放大的组合主体，用引线空框一秒交代核心利益点。
shots.textZone: 四角引线空框位与右上空圆章

shots.intent: 用膏体本体的蜡质纹理与抹痕证明肤感，替代任何功效话术。
shots.textZone: 中央空白标题带与三条空标签线

shots.intent: 用同框双包与箭头的更替结构承接换新预期，主张全部留空。
shots.textZone: 两包上方空标牌位与顶部空标题区

shots.intent: 手持单品对天空的仰拍代入随身补涂，留出大面积文案空间。
shots.textZone: 右侧 45% 干净留白供文案

shots.intent: 补涂动作的真实使用瞬间，让买家把自己代入日常护理习惯。
2x2 分格让每支护唇住进自己的食材世界，一次交代可选口味。
俯视全景平铺组合与对应食材，让口味选择一眼可比。
shots.textZone: 左下空白标题区，仅一条占位文案

shots.intent: 复刻挂卡背板的图标加参数结构，规格承诺全部留空占位。
shots.textZone: 顶部标题条、四格图标标签位、三行空参数线与底部空条

shots.intent: 挂卡盒与散装同框等高并排，消除到货内容疑虑。
户外情绪加空徽章结构承接信任区，资质一律留成空白框。
shots.textZone: 右侧空章与标签位，仅两条占位文案

shots.intent: 低机位纵深长列加空白优惠条收口，推动整组下单。
shots.textZone: 顶部空标题带与底部空优惠条

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF sweep for the packshot family, warm ivory boards #F5F1E6 and #F2EDE3 for overhead screens, one saturated tinted ground #F6C021 or #5AA6D3 when a flavour block needs its own color
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent color #D62B3A, badges drawn only as empty double-ring outlines with no filled-in marks
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with generous fill, soft contact shadows only, gentle shoulder speculars on the tube caps, around 5600K with a warm lift outdoors
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sunny apothecary lip-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F5F1E6, saturated yolk yellow #F6C021, berry red accent #D62B3A and clear-sky blue #5AA6D3; bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, generous fill and soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif type family with placeholder-only in-image wording; thin single-weight line icons and empty outline badges; stable product scale with the label face turned to the camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no filled-in badges or seals.
noDrift: no color palette changes outside the locked hexes
no mixed fonts and no serif display lettering
no inconsistent lighting or hard cast shadows
no filled-in badges, seals, ratings or origin marks
no props that cover the product label
style.presentationRules: stable product scale with the label face turned to the camera; variant tubes always upright in a row, side by side in the pack, or laid on easy diagonals in overhead screens; caps always off-frame or placed as a separate prop, never mid-swipe
style.surfaceSystem: matte ivory laminate board #F0EADB for flat screens, a low-gloss reflective sheet #F2EDE4 for the lineup shot, sunlit grass and open sky for scene shots
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for labels and callouts, placeholder-only in-image wording, no serif display lettering and no handwriting
